These shoes incorporate elements from Nike's long-distance running models, such as the Zoom Fly, giving them a natural forward tilt that propels the body as you move. This feature came in handy during a recent trip filled with extensive walking. The sensation is akin to gliding on the pavement with each step.
Breaking in the Air Max DN was a breeze. Once accustomed to their feel, it seems as though you are floating along with them. The thicker shoelaces are a practical touch, making them easy to untangle and tighten for optimal comfort.

Drawing inspiration from the Air Max 97s, the lined patterns enveloping the shoes lend a distinct look while still paying tribute to the original design. The elevated heel, accentuated with Air Max bubbles, not only boosts comfort but also ensures that the shoes' lineage is recognizable.
While they serve their purpose well, I would have appreciated greater breathability at the front of the shoe. raw_review_text: The Air Max DN is a new fresh look and feel, but honestly a take on an already established and familiar Air Max cushioning system of the early 2000s. Great fit, stylish and feel nonetheless, and more sleeker in appearance, but more reminiscing of the Air Max Tubular from 2001. I can definitely appreciate the effort conceptually put in to this new generation of Air Max this time around, but as a proponent and collector of Air Max for 30 years now, these as good as they look and feel I may add, are honestly in my opinion a rehash of the Air Max Tubular of 2001 just retooled and sleeker. | [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Out the box and onto the feet, These shoes give you the extreme comfort just like all the Nike Air Max’s do! I really enjoy them for walking and daily activities. I wear them to Disney often now as one of my go-to shoes. They broke in very easily as well. If there was any cons I could say, it’s that I wish the design was tweaked to look not as bulky. I do feel they are bulkier than other Air Max’s I own. Other than that, I really enjoy these shoes! | Would love to see these in all white, white/red bubbles! | [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I love the look and feel of these shoes! I really enjoy this shoe.  Aesthetically, it looks incredibly cool and futuristic! It has a durable “dotted” material and four cool air bubbles in the sole of the shoe.  At first glance it appears that it may be bulky but it’s really not and the slight elevation enhances the wear experience.  The elevation of the heel made the feel of the shoe incredibly comfortable.  I really only have one complaint about the shoe and that is at the toe of the shoe.  The little clear plastic part that I believe most air max shoes have was a bit uncomfortable at times.  It’s was not a continuous or pronounced discomfort but subtly noticed when my toe would sometimes touch the area.  I think it was more noticeable because the material of the shoe is very sturdy and durable versus a more cloth like material of a vapormax.  I would still recommend the shoe because it looks and feels great overall! | Shoes look and feel great! The new air max design is amazing and stylish. Whether I’m doing functional fitness, walking, jogging or running they meet all my expectations. The new air max are comfortable and very light weight on my feet. Only question I have is “How many color options?” | [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] The fit was amazing! I’m a size 9.5 so the shoe runs true to size. The new Dn air tubes provided lots of cushion and support. The design was sleek and stylish. I was able to wear them casually, as well as during workouts on treadmill and strength training. The upper fabric was breathable and comfortable as the shoe molded to my feet.    Right out of the box these new Ava Rover sneakers from Nike make a bold statement - bright, tri-tone colors blend smoothly together in five different types of material, with waves of texture that evoke a modern style. Swoosh is vibrantly colored and placed on the outer upper where it’s easy to see. Silhouette looks hefty, but speedy. 

   Definitely a unique design, but put together in a thoughtful way; not the kind of tasteless indulgence some other brands get caught up in.


[Fit & Feel]
   The Rovers fit true to size. Snug, but comfortable both walking and when seated.  Soles have plenty of support for hard surfaces. Sturdy structure yet (I was surprised to find) very lightweight overall. Nobbby outsole gives solid traction on smooth surfaces. Upper feltlike material feels very breathable. Laces are well-made and well-strung. 

   One clever design feature worth mentioning is that the heel tab is subtly textured for enhanced grip - plus it adds a splash of color matching the brand logo. Looks cool, works great! 

   The only element I didn’t like is the texture band between heel and collar; it’s left with an upward-facing flap that will undoubtedly catch debris over time and likely add an unnecessarily visible point of wear & tear as it rubs against the cuff of denim jeans or any other sturdy pants. I’d suggest stitching the top edge of this band in a future version.


[Verdict]
   High quality materials and good craftsmanship top-to-bottom — you can be sure you’re getting Nike’s best work when you snag a pair of Avas. Their bold, modern, comfortable design will have you sporting colors you never thought you’d see yourself in. Great look with with both jeans and khakis. Do yourself a favor and take these for a spin! | My son has wide feet  and absolutely loves them! I ordered them true to size and they seemed to have extra give to them so he was comfortable!

[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I really wanted to love these shoes. I love the retro look and how sleek they are. They also stand out with how clean the design is. They were comfortable to wear, however the issue is that they run narrow particularly in the middle. I do not have wide feet nor do I need to buy wide shoes. I could feel the middle of my feet not having stability as the middle sole was too narrow. I could also see the middle of the shoe was protruding out as well. Though they run narrow they still felt comfortable. As many of Nike's shoes, you can see and feel the quality. I have not worn them for an extended period of time so that comfortability factor may change. As I would wear these for mainly fashion, sadly I would not be wearing them much. I see they are made in a different country, perhaps that has something to do with it. | [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Design - hit, with some drawbacks. Simple color scheme but with just the right amount of bright color to give it a unique look and accentuate the shape of the midsole of the shoe. The high curve tip is an interesting design piece that gives me a throwback vibe but I think it's also the flaw of this shoe.

Fit - miss. these are size 11M but they fit like size 10, or 10.5 at best. I believe the design of the tip is causing the fit issues because it's pushing up against my toes quite a bit exactly at the point where the curve of the tip connects to the toebox. I could immediately tell the fit is off as soon as I put my foot in. 

Comfort - miss due to poor fit/design as mentioned above. However, I like the way the shoe hugs my foot without having to pull the laces so tight. I normally tuck my laces in so this is a plus. If the size fitting wasn't an issue I think this shoe would be comfortable to wear all day.

The shoes have a great retro look with the large Nike logos and great upper shoe style.  I normally wear shoes that don’t stand out, but these shoes with their bright white leather, shiny Nike logos, and blue trim along the bottom make me proud to wear a shoe that does stand out.  I feel instantly younger wearing these cool looking shoes.

The fit of the shoes is very comfortable.  They are surprisingly roomy in the toe box even though they look slender in this area.  I’ve worn them all day, but primarily on days where I’m not on my feet all day.  I suspect they wouldn’t be comfortable if I was on my feet all day such as at a theme park or a zoo.  I suspect this based on the arch support being slightly less than I would like, and the midsole cushion not being quite as cushiony as I would like for a day completely on my feet on pavement.  

With that said, these shoes are still very comfortable to wear for your typical day.  They are not too hot, which was a concern since they have completely leather uppers.  The shoe interior is well cushioned and didn’t create any rubs on my foot.  The heel feels slightly loose, but not to the point where it feels like your heel is sliding around or going to get a blister.  I felt well supported in these shoes, and the tread seems to have great grip.

I’m very pleased with these shoes and would recommend them to anyone looking for a hip new athletic casual shoe to wear.  They have great style and also great comfort.  The retro tread style reminds me of something my grandparents wore, but in a way that doesn’t make me feel old, but instead trendy.  The only thing I would maybe change is the tread pattern.  It provides fantastic grip, but it also appears to have great grip for keeping mud in the tread.  I will need to make sure I wear these on dry days or pavement to prevent mud for getting stuck in the tread grooves.  That is a minor annoyance, and all in all I think these are great shoes. As far as performance I felt the shox gave a bit of a boost to my running and sprints, and a literal spring in my step around the gym, which was appreciated. They definitely give you some volume to your height as the shoes are pretty high off the ground due to the soles/shocks. 
As far as fit goes it wasn’t my preferred. The toe box is quite narrow— wide footed people take note. The fabric of the shoe is also quite thick and I would guess my feet would feel very hot outdoors in the hotter months. The sole is super stiff, not allowing for much flexing in the foot while exercising and also creating a bit of a rub/ shoes lifting off the back of my heels. I don’t know if the sole would get more flexible over time, but it was too stiff for me to want to choose this as my go-to exercising shoe. 

Overall I think it’s a cool shoe with that classic nike shox look, but I wouldn’t choose it for regular exercise. | [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] These are cool shoes, very early 00s. I also wish they had more detail on them. I know some people like the all black look and I like black shoes too, but these felt like they could use some contrast. That’s just personal preference though so not letting that affect my rating.

When walking, I noticed that the shoes seem to shift my weight more toward my toes—possibly due to the Shox cushioning in the heel. I'm not sure if this will improve with wear, but it feels a bit different from other sneakers I own.

Design-wise, they aren’t my usual style. The look leans a bit more masculine than I typically go for, so if you prefer a sleek or feminine aesthetic, these might not be the best choice. That said, the quality seems good, and they look sporty. Overall, a decent pair of shoes, but not an instant favorite for me. | [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I’m really happy with these shoes overall! They fit great and are true to size, which is always a big plus. The soles are incredibly comfortable and feel like they melt around my feet, providing excellent support. However, the shoestring area feels a bit tight on my foot, though I think that might improve as I wear them more.

I absolutely love the look of these shoes—stylish and classic! I had a pair when they first came out, so I was excited to get them again. The color is fantastic. I’ve worn them for walking and running errands, and my feet didn’t ache afterward, which is a huge bonus.

Overall, a solid pair of shoes that I’m happy to have in my collection! | I couldn’t wait to get these, so I was really disappointed when I tried them on. raw_review_text:
[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] In the 2000s, I remember thinking that the Nike Shox were so cool, so I was super pumped to see that the style has been revived for 2025! The black on black coloring is my favorite, since they match with almost anything and will hide dirt well. I usually wear a size 8 in Nikes, and the thick leather made these bit snug at first, but loosened up the more I wore them. Inside the shoe, the plush cushioning provides comfort for my everyday needs. As a busy mom of two, I try to get workouts in when I can, so I also use these to walk on my indoor walking pad. They gripped the pad well, and provided me with good support during my walks. They even add a bit of height, which my 5'2" frame appreciates. The only thing I'd change about these is that the laces are a bit short. I have to pull the laces really tight for the laces to be long enough to tie properly. Overall, I'd recommend these shoes if you're looking for a stylish and comfortable sneaker. | One my fav sneaker pared well with my new coat can’t wait to wear them this weekend | Very heavy I wouldn’t recommend wearing them all day!! But they look very good great quality | [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] The Nike Shox shoes impressed me more than I thought they would. Right when I pulled them out of the box they appeared to be heavy which I was surprised by. They feel well-made with quality materials. The exterior material is very practical and easy to clean. 

The shoes are true to size or even a little small. The fit feels snug and stiff. My feet are comfortable in them with plenty of room at the toes. All around my foot however, is where they feel a little tight. I’m not able to wear too thick of socks. The shoelaces are a little short, making it difficult for a double knot which I always like when I am running. So far though my shoelaces haven’t come undone while exercising. 

Having a high-performance shoe is important to me because I have knee issues. If I am not wearing quality shoes when working out I feel it the rest of the day. The Nike Shox R4 Shoes absorb a significant amount of the impact when I am running. That is my favorite time to wear these shoes. I have used them at the gym as well for volleyball and basketball. I feel stable in them, with excellent support. I tried wearing them as daily use shoes and they feel a little restrictive for me. I had to get used to wearing them because the heel height is higher than anything else I own. I will continue to use them for running and impact sports.

Overall, a quality shoe that I would recommend to others for running and high- impact exercise.

[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I am in love with these shoes! I got the black pair, and I find that they are super practical, very comfortable, and extremely versatile. I appreciate that these can easily go with jeans for more of a retro-streetwear style, or with leggings and a sweatshirt for a cute comfy outfit. I got the 7.5, though I generally range from 7 to 7.5, and these fit me perfectly. Since I have kind of wide feet in the toe area, I generally need shoes with a large toe box, and these definitely fit the bill without seeming too clunky. They're a really good level of "chunky" for my taste, without making it seem like I have clown feet. I did think that it I had to break them in a bit, but after approximately a mile or two of walking around in them they conformed to my feet really well. I also really loved the shiny accents mixed in with the mesh for a really retro look, as I find that it gives them a bit of personality. I would say that as someone who definitely relies on a lot of mileage in my shoes (I walk around a lot) they're great. That said, I would not attempt to run in these.
